scenario.title: 55.0 C is a legal cell temperature, 55.1 C faults
scenario.description: Walk the over-temperature limit across its exclusive boundary. At exactly 550 dC the pack must stay quiet on the fault identifier, with the reading confirmed by a read-back of the rule's own input. One tenth of a degree higher the fault frame must carry OVERTEMP. The fault must then survive the pack cooling to 25.0 C, because rule 1 is latched. This is the scenario that separates firmware/bms from firmware/bms-broken.

steps.params: hottest cell driven to exactly 55.0 C, the limit itself

params.label: 55.0 C is legal: no fault frame for 300 ms
the value the rule compares really is 55.0 C
still legal 600 ms in: nothing about 55.0 C is a fault

steps.params: one tenth of a degree above the limit

params.label: 55.1 C faults with OVERTEMP within 50 ms
the pack publishes the 55.1 C it faulted on

steps.params: pack cooled to 25.0 C, the fault must not clear

params.label: OVERTEMP stays latched after the pack cools to 25.0 C
